newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Oct industry capacity use rises to 85 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Oct industry capacity use rises to 85 pct.

text.p: A survey by an independent Brazilian research institute shows that capacity utilization in industry reached 85 percent in October, one of the highest rates of the 1980s and 90s.
October's rate is the highest since April 1995 and October 1986 when capacity utilization reached 86 percent, the survey by the Fundacao Getulio Vargas (FGV) said.
The FGV survey covered 1,558 companies whose combined turnover in 1995 was around 117 billion reais ($113.6 billion).
Of the companies surveyed, 47 percent increased production in the July to September period, while only 15 percent saw a decline in output.
Production is expected to grow further in the fourth quarter of 1996 by 35 percent of the companies in the survey, while 17 percent expect output to fall in the fourth quarter.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
